title: Kaufman Children's Center * - Videos
description:
Kaufman Children's Center for Speech, Language, Sensory-Motor & Autism Treatment is a leader in innovative treatment programs that help young kids live their very best lives. KCC is also the home of childhood apraxia of speech expert Nancy R. Kaufman and a really fun place to learn and grow!

Since 1979, Nancy has dedicated herself to establishing the Kaufman Speech to Language Protocol (K-SLP), a treatment approach to help children become effective vocal communicators. Many of the videos here on the KCC are of Nancy working directly with children to bring out their very best. 

We're so glad you're here and welcome any questions!
